basic_info.description: his approximately 1,790 square foot home offers three bedrooms and one bathroom on the main level and is on the market for the first time in more than 50 years! Two of the main level bedrooms have ocean views.    The warranted space down is well-proportioned, offering versatile space for a variety of uses and one full bathroom.    The living room has a fireplace and there are hardwood floors throughout adding warmth and character to the home. The gas kitchen is connected to the formal dining area making it ideal for entertaining.    Year built: 1941  Square footage: 1794 (per tax records)
